summary: Costamare Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders to be held virtually on October 6, 2026. The record date is August 11, 2026, and the proxy statement will be sent around August 12, 2026. This is a routine meeting notice with no special situation such as a transaction, activist campaign, or management change. The filing contains no material corporate event beyond scheduling the annual meeting.
